# Changelog 2026-10-05

- Add support for submission of datasets following Metadata Standard v3.0.0
- Add deployment of metadata-submitter service for pilot testing
- Add MFA requirement when logging in to acquire download or upload token
- Add deployment of download-v2 service along side download(v1)
- Download(v1) can utilize multiple buckets so no need for the `download2.bp.nbis.se` endpoint
- Use finalize backup functionality for file backups instead of sync service
